hooks.command: MODULE=$(echo "$CLAUDE_FILE_PATH" | grep -oE '(common|clients|ingest|worker|scheduler|groupware)' | head -1); if [ -n "$MODULE" ]; then ./gradlew :$MODULE:compileJava --no-daemon -q 2>&1 | tail -5; fi
if echo "$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT" | grep -q 'git push.*main'; then echo 'BLOCKED: main 직접 푸시 금지 — PR을 통해 merge' && exit 1; fi
